h: Hearing Divine Consolation Afresh in Every Generation

p: It says in the Pesikta (the new one):
are you saying you came to comfort
I came to comfort all the generations;
'your God said' is not written here,
was said then to the prophet
but for the generations to come
so how can "your God will say" apply
through whom will He say it?
It should have said "your God said"
according to what it says in the Pesikta (the old one),
that they would not accept consolation
and the Holy One, blessed is He, said:
I and you will go to her
are also the word of Hashem;
so what consolation does He add
But the matter is, as is known,
for he prophesied with "This is the thing"
(as is written in the Sifrei, Matos,
which is the explicit word of Hashem;
and this is the lens that shines
And we said that this is the meaning
of what is said at the beginning of Sefer Devarim:
which is like "This is the thing,"
For although the book of Mishneh Torah
is the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
the Written Torah and the Oral,
And one who reads the parsha
that is, through the shining lens.
And about this it is written (Yeshayahu 55:11):
that goes out of My mouth;
it shall not return to Me empty," etc.
Now here in the consolation of Tziyon
it is written, "Speak to the heart of Yerushalayim,"
but they did not accept consolation,
for it did not enter the heart;
who were at the time of the Destruction,
and their returning after seventy years
But the essence of the consolation
that is, that willful sins become like merits,
that through this they will have rest in exile;
in the manner of what it says
"For more are the children of the desolate
than the children of the married wife"
she raised up for Me in her destruction,
she raised up for Me in her building."
hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh.
And this did not enter their hearts,
עַל זֶה אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
On this the Holy One, blessed is He, said,
and it will be like "This is the thing
and "My word that goes out of My mouth
shall not return to Me empty,
כִּי אִם עָשָׂה אֲשֶׁר חָפַצְתִּי וְגוֹ׳
but it shall accomplish what I desire," etc.;
and through this they will accept the consolation
and it will enter the heart.
And this is what they said:
"Are you saying you came to comfort
for what will it help the generations?
How will the consolations enter the heart,
since it is already written in a book
and will have no more power
And about this it says "your God will say":
when they read in the books of the prophets
then at the time of reading
and it will be the explicit word of Hashem
and it will enter the heart,
so that they accept the consolations.
from the mouth of Hashem Himself
And it is a preparation for Rosh Hashanah,
that they be redeemed in Tishrei
